decisions.reason: Nine of nine held-out mice have positive effects against both endpoints; standardized medians exceed the frozen threshold. Source labels are reused, and visible stress-related genes make specificity checks essential.
targeted_checks: Rank score invariant to positive per-cell scaling
Every fold excluded its held-out mouse during filtering and ranking
Fold gene-set Jaccard with full candidate 0.639-0.786

decisions.reason: Both source endpoint directions survive depth matching in all nine mice with >=30 matched cells/state; all nine exceed endpoint-mixture controls. Nineteen of 50 genes overlap generic controls, so the normal-context transfer is informative about scope, not optional proof of specificity.
decisions.limitations: Matched-set comparisons are conditional on discovery; stress is not proven absent; activated AT2 is not a validated pure-stress negative control.

decisions.reason: Frozen primary transfers in the one qualifying developmental group but is near zero in the two qualifying intestinal mice; the pre-transfer 31-gene variant is positive in both intestinal mice and merits a focused depth check.
decisions.post_transfer_scope_addition: 200 matching draws for existing frozen scores; no new gene selection or branch retuning.

decisions.reason: Primary intestinal effects remain near zero or negative vs Stem. The 31-gene variant changes sign vs Stem in Mouse1 after depth matching; only Mouse3 retains >=30 matched cells/state. Positive developmental evidence is one capture group, not independent replication.
decisions.remaining_uncertainty: Small sample counts, matched-subset loss and normalized developmental input prevent exclusion of weaker shared components or a shared non-transcriptional process.
decisions.next_investment: A later bounded test in an independently replicated normal epithelial transition could be informative; current results do not justify atlas integration, regulatory-network fitting or causal perturbation selection from this candidate.

decisions.reason: All warranted stages executed; numerical, provenance, freeze, link and figure checks pass. Broad expansion stopped at E3a; original replication gaps remain.
